summary: SPAC Real Asset Acquisition Corp. (RAAQ) filed an 8-K announcing an additional $12M PIPE commitment from Ilmarinen for its business combination with IQM Finland Oy, a quantum computing company, bringing total PIPE commitments to over $146M. The transaction was originally disclosed in a February 22, 2026 Business Combination Agreement. IQM will become publicly traded via the de-SPAC merger. A registration statement on Form F-4 (proxy/prospectus) has been filed. The deal requires shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting. Watch for SEC effectiveness of the F-4 and shareholder vote; risk-arb focuses on redemption levels and PIPE backstop sufficiency.
